title: Page 5
content_zh:
一个星期之后，肖崇源才发觉自己真的低估温宁的执着了。
“肖院长，又见面了。”
“请把‘又’字加无限次方。”肖崇源停下手边的工作，用两指撑着额角，脸色不善地看着推门而入的小女人。
温宁今天穿了一件驼色的无袖衬衫和水洗牛仔裤，脚下是一双浅色的鱼口鞋，粉嫩的脚趾露在外面，她落落大方地走进他的办公室，在对面的沙发上坐下，长腿一叠，“只要你答应手术，那我就不会再来烦你了。”
“想都别想。”
“我们经理说，手术费是可以商量的，如果你有别的要求也可以提，我们经理都会酌情满足，我们经理还说……”
“你们经理的话可真多。”肖崇源不耐烦地打断她，口气有点古怪，“怎么不干脆让你们经理来和我谈？”
温宁眨了眨眼，“我们经理很忙的。”
肖崇源夸张地哼笑了一声：“既然你们经理这么厉害，那还找我做什么，让他来做手术。”
温宁“嘶”了一声，“你这人……”
肖崇源抬起手臂，“我这人怎么样？我也很忙的。”
温宁瞪了他一会，好半天过后气一泄，半是抱怨半是恳求地说：“肖崇源，你就不能放下我们过去的事吗？现在我是代表公司来和你谈的，你不要总把个人恩怨掺在里面！”
“温小姐，不要太高估自己。”肖崇源轻轻一笑，“我不做这个手术，和你没关系。”
温宁这下倒是傻了，“那是为什么？”
肖崇源吊人胃口地顿了顿，继而接着说：“单纯是因为我不、想、做。”
温宁的鼻子都要被他气歪了，单纯不想做？身为一个医疗业者，用这个理由来拒绝手术真的合适吗？他这么不负责，他们院长知道吗？哦，好吧，她忘了肖崇源就是这里的院长了。
温宁调匀呼吸，把包包往旁边一摔，“肖崇源，你就是故意整我是不是？”
肖崇源慢条斯理地看着手中的病例，轻飘飘地甩给她一句，“温小姐，你要是这个态度，我们就没有什么好谈的了。”说完他伸手按下电话，对着那头说：“准备得怎么样了？”
“助理、器材、手术室、病人，一切就绪。”
“嗯。”肖崇源挂断电话，整理了一下桌面，接着起身就要走。

“喂，你别走。”温宁猛然站起来，几步跟上去，“我态度好一点还不行吗？我们继续谈。”
“温小姐，我现在有个手术要做。”肖崇源露出制式化的笑容，稍一颔首，“那么……”说完也不顾温宁要说什么就推门离开。
温宁踩着高跟鞋跟上去，结果办公室的玻璃门却先一步挡在她面前，差点贴上她的小鼻头。
温宁气呼呼地透过玻璃门瞪着肖崇源颀长的背影，狠狠一跺脚，真是气死她了，要不是为了保住工作，她才不要去求他！
肖崇源今天的手术比较麻烦，做了将近六个小时才做完，他换下手术服，又在休息室歇了一会后才回办公室，此时已经是下午四点钟。
肖崇源腰酸背痛地走到办公室外，眼睛一抬就看到了温宁，她居然还在？他在玻璃门外站定，并没有走进去，而是细细地打量着她。
温宁盘腿坐在沙发上，面前的茶几上摆着披萨盒，肖崇源轻笑，心想她倒悠闲，竟然自己叫起外送来了。
温宁本来在看手机，后来手机似乎震动起来，她立刻接听，脸上瞬间洋溢起灿烂的笑容来，“经理。”
肖崇源一看她那个表情就觉得不对劲，情不自禁地把头贴近，无奈自己这个办公室的隔音效果实在太好，什么都听不到。
他想了想，转而走到玻璃门前，轻手轻脚地把门开了一条缝，刚想弯腰偷听就想自己干嘛要这样，他动了动肩膀后想直起腰，但在听到里面飘出来的声音后又不禁停住动作。
“对不起、对不起……我知道，经理，我会尽力的……不会不会，您、您别生气，都是我不好。”办公室里的温宁一直在和电话那头的人道歉，口气低声下气得可以。
肖崇源的眉头不自觉地拧起，忍不住又把直起来的腰给弯了下去……
肖崇源一直偷听到温宁挂断电话才直起腰，从鼻子里不屑地哼出一声，莫名地变得烦躁，他索性把门推开，瞥见温宁慌乱地抹了抹眼睛，显然是刚才被电话那边的经理给骂哭了。
肖崇源视若无睹地走进来，“办公室里又没风，你的眼睛怎么了？”
温宁吸了吸鼻子，调整好声音，“那是因为等你等得想睡觉，呵欠都打了一下午了。”
第2章(2)
肖崇源冷着脸去
温宁难得配合地把盒盖盖上，又装进塑胶袋，“你不是爱吃洋葱吗？”
“喜欢吃，不代表也喜欢闻。”肖崇源面无表情地往办公椅一坐，“现在不是叙旧的时候，温小姐，你该下班了。”一句“温小姐”硬生生地把两个人的距离拉得好远。
温宁刚刚被经理训完，现在满心想的都是怎么搞定手术，所以也不管尊严不尊严了，一咬牙就冲到办公桌前，抓着桌边悲戚地说：“肖院长，算我拜托你了，我知道我们的关系令你很为难，但这关系到我的职业，你就不能当我是陌生人，抛开一切芥蒂来正视一下这件事吗？替蒙娜做手术，对你而言根本没有任何损失啊！”

“我考虑一下。”
“啊？”
“我说我会考虑一下。”
“那……”这么突然就松口了？
“你再烦我，就连考虑的机会都没了。”
温宁瞬间闭嘴。
“赶快回家，别在我这里杵着。”肖崇源嫌弃地挥了挥手。
“好好，那你好好考虑一下喔。”温宁急忙点头。
“把垃圾也带走。”
“嗯嗯。”温宁做了个OK的手势，收拾起垃圾和包包就准备闪人，走出办公室后，她又折回来，探了个头进来嘱咐道：“你一定要好好、好好地考虑一下。”
见肖崇源不耐烦地挥手之后，温宁一吐舌头，乖乖地缩回脑袋滚远了。
她离开后，那股洋葱味许久都还没散去，肖崇源郁闷地拿出香水到处喷了喷，接着去倒了杯水，站在窗口往下看。
那抹倩影很快就出现在视野中，温宁今天走路的节奏很轻快，显然心情极好，蹦蹦跳跳地走出医院大门。
肖崇源撇嘴，浅抿了口温水，接着下意识地冷哼道：“原来你也会有被人骂哭的时候。”
她口中的那位经理到底是什么角色？之前他们吵架时，温宁都没哭过，都这么骂她了，温宁还一口一个“我们经理”叫着，真是没骨气。
肖崇源莫名其妙地觉得气闷，就好像原先属于自己的玩具，现在却被别人踩了一脚般，让人心里很不舒服。
他都快忘了温宁对他低声下气是什么时候的事了，那要追溯到结婚的前几个月了，那时的她温柔又体贴，还会操持家务，简直是个理想的妻子人选，可之后呢，耍脾气、任性、胡闹……
他以为她是取下矫正器后就原形毕露，但现在再看，她竟然也有温顺的时候，只不过她温顺的对象已经不再是他，而是那个叫做“我们经理”的诡异生物……
肖崇源捏紧了水杯，一遍又一遍地想，凭什么！温宁凭什么总是和自己作对，却对一个小经纪公司的经理唯命是从？她欠那个经理什么了？要说欠，她欠最多的人是他肖崇源才对！
content_en:
A week later, Xiao Chongyuan realized that he had really underestimated Wen Ning's persistence.
"Dean Xiao, we meet again."
"Please raise the word 'again' to the infinite power." Xiao Chongyuan stopped what he was doing, propped up his forehead with two fingers, and looked at the little woman who walked in through the door with an unkind expression.
Wen Ning wore a camel sleeveless shirt and washed jeans today, and a pair of light-colored fish-top shoes, with her pink toes exposed. She walked into his office gracefully, sat down on the sofa opposite, folded her legs, and said, "As long as you agree to the surgery, I won't bother you anymore."
"Don't even think about it."
"Our manager said that the surgery fee is negotiable. If you have other requirements, you can make them and our manager will meet them as appropriate. Our manager also said..."
"Your manager talks a lot." Xiao Chongyuan interrupted her impatiently, his tone was a little weird, "Why don't you just let your manager come and talk to me?"
Wen Ning blinked, "Our manager is very busy."
Xiao Chongyuan snorted exaggeratedly: "Since your manager is so powerful, why are you asking me to do the surgery?"
Wen Ning hissed, "You..."
Xiao Chongyuan raised his arm, "How am I doing? I'm also very busy."
Wen Ning stared at him for a while, and after a long time, he lost his temper. He said half complaining and half pleading: "Xiao Chongyuan, can't you let go of our past? Now I am here to talk to you on behalf of the company, so don't always mix personal grudges into it!"
"Miss Wen, don't overestimate yourself." Xiao Chongyuan smiled softly, "If I don't do this surgery, it has nothing to do with you."
Wen Ning was dumbfounded now, "Why is that?"
Xiao Chongyuan paused appetizingly, and then continued: "Simply because I don't want to do it."
Wen Ning's nose was so angry that he was so angry that he just didn't want to do it? As a medical professional, is it really appropriate to use this reason to refuse surgery? Does their dean know that he is so irresponsible? Oh, okay, she forgot that Xiao Chongyuan is the dean here.
Wen Ning calmed his breathing and threw the bag to the side, "Xiao Chongyuan, are you just trying to mess with me?"
Xiao Chongyuan looked at the case in his hand slowly and said to her lightly, "Ms. Wen, if you have this attitude, we will have nothing to talk about." After saying that, he reached out and pressed the phone and said to the other end: "How are you preparing?"
"Assistants, equipment, operating room, patients, everything is ready."
"Yes." Xiao Chongyuan hung up the phone, tidied the desktop, then stood up and left.
"Hey, don't leave." Wen Ning stood up suddenly and followed him a few steps, "Can't I be nicer? Let's continue talking."
"Ms. Wen, I have an operation to do now." Xiao Chongyuan showed a formal smile and nodded, "Then..." After saying that, he opened the door and left regardless of what Wen Ning had to say.
Wen Ning stepped on her high heels to follow, but the glass door of the office blocked her in front of her, almost touching her nose.
Wen Ning angrily glared at Xiao Chongyuan's tall back through the glass door and stamped her foot. She was really angry. If it wasn't to keep her job, she wouldn't have asked him!
Xiao Chongyuan's surgery today was quite troublesome. It took nearly six hours to complete. He changed out of his surgical clothes and rested in the lounge for a while before returning to the office. It was already four o'clock in the afternoon.
Xiao Chongyuan walked out of the office with a sore back and raised his eyes to see Wen Ning. She was actually still there? He stood outside the glass door, not walking in, but looking at her carefully.
Wen Ning sat cross-legged on the sofa, with a pizza box on the coffee table in front of her. Xiao Chongyuan chuckled, thinking that she was so leisurely that she even called for delivery.
Wen Ning was looking at her phone, but then it seemed to vibrate. She immediately answered it, with a bright smile on her face., "Manager."
Xiao Chongyuan felt something was wrong when he saw her expression, and couldn't help but put his head close to her. Unfortunately, the sound insulation effect of his office was so good that he couldn't hear anything.
He thought for a moment, then walked to the glass door and opened the door open a crack. Just as he was about to bend down and eavesdrop, he thought about why he was doing this. He moved his shoulders and wanted to straighten up, but he couldn't help but stop when he heard the sound coming from inside.
"I'm sorry, I'm sorry... I know, manager, I will try my best... No, no, no, no, don't be angry, it's all my fault." Wen Ning in the office kept apologizing to the person on the other end of the phone, in a low and angry tone.
Xiao Chongyuan's brows wrinkled unconsciously, and he couldn't help but bend his straightened waist again...
Xiao Chongyuan didn't straighten up until he overheard Wen Ning hanging up the phone. He snorted disdainfully from his nose and became inexplicably irritable. He simply pushed the door open and saw Wen Ning wiping his eyes in panic. He was obviously scolded by the manager on the other side of the phone.
Xiao Chongyuan walked in as if he didn't see anything, "There's no wind in the office, what's wrong with your eyes?"
Wen Ning sniffed and adjusted his voice, "That's because I've been yawning all afternoon while waiting for you."
Chapter 2(2)
Xiao Chongyuan went with a cold face
Wen Ning closed the lid of the box with rare cooperation and put it into a plastic bag, "Don't you love onions?"
"Just because you like to eat, doesn't mean you also like to smell." Xiao Chongyuan sat down on the office chair with an expressionless expression, "Now is not the time to reminisce about old times, Miss Wen, it's time for you to get off work." The words "Miss Wen" abruptly distanced the two people.
Wen Ning had just been trained by the manager, and now all he could think about was how to get the surgery done, so he didn't care about his dignity. He gritted his teeth and rushed to the desk. He grabbed the edge of the table and said sadly: "Dean Xiao, I'm going to leave you alone. I know that our relationship makes you very embarrassed, but it is related to my career. Can't you just treat me as a stranger and put aside all your grudges to face this matter? You have nothing to lose by doing Mona's surgery!"
"I'll think about it."
"Huh?"
"I said I'd think about it."
"Then..." He let go so suddenly?
"If you bother me again, you won't even have a chance to think about it."
Wen Ning shut up instantly.
"Go home quickly, don't hang around here with me." Xiao Chongyuan waved his hand in disgust.
"Okay, then you should think about it carefully." Wen Ning nodded hurriedly.
"Take the trash away too."
"Yeah." Wen Ning made an OK gesture, packed up the trash and bags, and prepared to leave. After walking out of the office, she came back, poked her head in and said, "You must think about it carefully."
After seeing Xiao Chongyuan wave impatiently, Wen Ning stuck out his tongue, retracted his head obediently and rolled away.
After she left, the onion smell didn't dissipate for a long time. Xiao Chongyuan depressedly took out the perfume and sprayed it everywhere. Then he went to pour a glass of water and stood at the window to look down.
The beautiful figure soon appeared in the field of vision. Wen Ning walked very briskly today. He was obviously in a good mood and skipped out of the hospital door.
Xiao Chongyuan curled his lips, took a sip of warm water, and then subconsciously snorted: "So you will also cry when you are scolded."
What is the role of the manager she is talking about? When they quarreled before, Wen Ning didn't even cry. He scolded her like this. Wen Ning also kept calling her "our manager" one after another, which was really spineless.
Xiao Chongyuan felt inexplicably stuffy, as if a toy that originally belonged to him had been stepped on by someone else, which made him feel very uncomfortable.
He had almost forgotten when Wen Ning was talking down to him. It dates back to the first few months of marriage. At that time, she was gentle and considerate, and could also take care of the housework. She was an ideal wife.But after that, he acted out of temper, willfully, and mischievously...
He thought she had revealed her true colors after taking off the braces, but looking back now, she actually had her docile moments, but the person she was docile to was no longer him, but that strange creature called "our manager"...
Xiao Chongyuan squeezed the water glass tightly and thought over and over again, why! Why is Wen Ning always against him, yet he obeys the orders of the manager of a small brokerage company? What does she owe that manager? When it comes to debt, the person she owes the most to is Xiao Chongyuan!
